contentBlocks.text: You have every piece: what counts as ਖ਼ਬਰ, the inverted pyramid, and the five ਸਵਾਲ. Today, write a complete original news report.

Write a complete short news report (4-6 sentences) about a real, genuine event from your own life, school, or community this week. Structure it using the inverted pyramid: your opening sentence (from Day 3, revised) comes first, answering as many of the five ਸਵਾਲ as you can. Follow it with 2-4 more sentences adding supporting details, in order from most to least important. Before finishing, add a short ਸੁਰਖੀ (headline) above your report — a few words that capture its core in as little space as possible.
You've written a complete original news report using genuine journalistic structure. Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Write a complete 4-6 sentence news report using the inverted pyramid structure
Write a short headline (ਸੁਰਖੀ) capturing the report's core
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's three tools: ਖ਼ਬਰ definition, inverted pyramid, five ਸਵਾਲ.
2. Have the child draft their opening sentence, using Day 3's revision as a starting point.
3. Add 2-4 supporting-detail sentences in order of importance.
4. Write a short ਸੁਰਖੀ above the report.
5. Complete the worksheet.
6. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow a shorter 4-sentence report and provide a sentence-order checklist (opening, then supporting details, most to least important)
Ready for more: ask them to write two different ਸੁਰਖੀ options for the same report and explain which one is stronger and why
Every Gurmukhi word used in this lesson was checked against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: A complete answer is the child's own original 4-6 sentence news report, structured with the most important information first, answering multiple of the five ਸਵਾਲ, plus a short headline — content varies genuinely by student, evaluated against these structural criteria rather than a fixed 'correct' answer.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'advanced composition and an introduction to Punjabi-language media and journalism' description with a genuine composition capstone, synthesizing every tool introduced this week into one finished original piece.

generationData.instructions: Write your complete news report with a headline.
